instruction: A candid documentary photograph, full-length shot of a couple in a dimly lit indoor parking garage. On the right, the man in the black leather jacket (R1) stands facing forward, head turned slightly left. On the left, the woman in the black V-neck top (R2) stands facing forward, head turned right to look at him. They stand side-by-side, holding hands in the center with their inner hands clasped. The scene is lit by overhead fluorescent lights, casting soft shadows on the concrete floor in a cool, desaturated color palette.
